svg.title: Morphagene — unbranded, photo-derived 20 HP panel
svg.desc: Vector reconstruction of the supplied 810 x 1024 photograph. Soundhack and Make Noise logos omitted. Morphagene title retained. No embedded image, live text, masks, filters, or CSS. Physical controls are separate. Native dimensions 101.6 x 128.5 mm. All coordinates are photo-derived, not manufacturing data.
